support_vote.description: Is the claim, as stated, faithful and proportionate?

weakest_true_restatement.description: Required when support_vote is overstated or misattributed: the strongest version of the claim that is still defensible. Null otherwise.

resolving_work.description: Required to substantiate a solved or partially-solved vote. A vote without this is downgraded to open. Empty array otherwise.

locator.description: doi, arxiv id, pmid, CRAN package, or owner/repo@sha

counter_evidence.description: Verbatim text from a cited work or source file that contradicts the claim. Empty array if none.
